milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The green terracotta structure is centered at spawn-relative (6, 1, 6). max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk toward the structure (~8.5 blocks from spawn) rather than trivially satisfying from spawn by just turning. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining gray_terracotta with the provided iron pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. Gray terracotta is at spawn-relative (4-7, 0-3, 8), directly behind the green terracotta structure. Without a pickaxe terracotta wouldn't drop, but the scene provides an iron pickaxe.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brick slab platform is centered at spawn-relative (-6, 0, -5). max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk toward the structure (~7.8 blocks from spawn) rather than trivially satisfying from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_diorite_stairs with the provided iron pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The stairs column is at spawn-relative (-8, 0-3, -4 to -6), beside the brick slab platform. Without a pickaxe the stairs wouldn't drop, but the scene provides an iron pickaxe.
